caseName: National Ass'n for the Advancement of Colored People v. Claiborne Hardware Co.
caseNameFull: National Association for the Advancement of Colored People v. Claiborne Hardware Co.

opinions.text:
Sup. Ct. Miss. [Certiorari granted, ante, p. 1030.] Motions of American Jewish Congress and American Civil Liberties Union et al. for leave to file briefs as amici curiae granted.

Justice Marshall took no part in the consideration or decision of these motions.
